highlights.headline: Commission approves €5 billion German State aid scheme to support decarbonisation of industry
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 07 May 2026 The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, a €5 billion German scheme to help companies in industrial sectors decarbonise their production processes. The scheme contributes to achieving Germany's energy and climate targets, as well as the EU's sustainable prosperity and competitiveness objectives.

items.title: EU reaches tentative deal on simpler AI rules, plans ban on 'nudifier' apps
items.description: In a provisional deal, the European Union has agreed on a ban on the use of AI for creating pornographic deepfakes and sexualized imagery. It has also agreed on amending certain rules within the EU's AI Act.
